_comment: PROBE_SET_VERSION -> fingerprint of the probe set it names (tests/probe_set_fingerprint.py). Append a stamp whenever the probe set changes; never reuse a recorded one. On 2026-10-30 the report_accounting component was dropped from the fingerprint and every recorded fingerprint recomputed from its other recorded components. 'withdrawn' lists stamps issued for an unchanged probe set; they are not current-stamp candidates. Stamps before 2026.10.30.1 used the old date-only scheme and are listed in CHANGELOG.md, not here.
